## What it will cover

::: {.mm-stub-outline}
- Reading predicted structures and confidence (pLDDT, PAE)
- Secondary structure, solvent accessibility and contacts
- Structure-derived features for machine learning
- Comparing structures: RMSD, TM-score
- Structure-aware splits
- Lab 12: from predicted structures to a structure-feature model
:::

## Planned learning outcomes

1. Load predicted protein structures and interpret their confidence measures.
2. Compute structure-derived features and use them in a model.
3. Compare structures quantitatively and avoid leakage through structural similarity.

## In the meantime

Everything here builds on Part I, in particular the evaluation habits of [Chapter 2](../../part-1-foundations/ch02-ml-fundamentals/index.html). Episode [2.6](../../part-1-foundations/ch02-ml-fundamentals/06-pipelines-leakage.html) already introduces the group splits that become sequence-identity splits here.
